name: Alcami
event_blurb: Alcami is a contract development and manufacturing organization that provides end-to-end outsourcing solutions for pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, including drug development, testing, manufacturing, and packaging services.

name: August Bioservices at August Bio
event_blurb: August Bioservices is a U.S.-based CDMO specializing in sterile injectable drug development, analytical testing, and commercial manufacturing. From formulation and process development to fill-finish, packaging, and distribution, we provide an integrated, end-to-end solution that accelerates timelines while maintaining the highest standards of quality. Backed by advanced technology, Annex 1-compliant manufacturing, and a collaborative team of industry experts, we help bring innovative therapies from clinical development to commercial production, all from a single, trusted partner.

name: Bora Biologics
event_blurb:
Bora Biologics supports mammalian and microbial biologics programs from cell line development through late-stage and commercial drug substance manufacturing. Our FDA-registered San Diego facility anchors reliable U.S. commercial supply, while our Taiwan site provides agile clinical manufacturing and development support within a globally aligned quality system.
In partnership with Bora Pharmaceuticals, we extend that operational control through integrated U.S. drug product manufacturing, inspection, labeling, packaging, and stability services — enabling a streamlined, governance-aligned development-to-commercial pathway designed for continuity and long-term reliability.

name: Catachem
event_blurb:
Catachem, Inc. is a U.S.-based ISO 13485 certified developer and manufacturer of specialty diagnostic reagents, custom assay components, and lyophilized products for the in vitro diagnostics (IVD), biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and research markets. Since 1984, we have partnered with organizations ranging from emerging startups to global diagnostic manufacturers, providing end-to-end support from feasibility and formulation development through scale-up, manufacturing, quality control, and regulatory documentation.
Our core capabilities include custom reagent formulation, lyophilization process development and manufacturing, OEM/private-label production, calibrators and controls, buffers and specialty solutions, fill-finish services, and custom kit assembly. name: CRAMSN Research
event_blurb: CRAMSN is a leading Contract Research, Development, and Manufacturing Organization (CRO, CDMO, CMO) that offers end-to-end solutions and supports standalone programs with efficiency, quality, and consistency enabling faster go-to-market strategies. As a catalyst for change, we are committed to reducing our carbon footprint through sustainable practices. Our objectives include utilizing green chemistry across our services to minimize our carbon footprint. Solar-powered facilities and maintaining 50% green cover help us move closer to achieving net-zero waste.

name: Fresenius Kabi
event_blurb: Fresenius Kabi Contract Manufacturing partners with pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to deliver reliable sterile injectable manufacturing solutions backed by the strength, quality standards, and operational expertise of a global pharmaceutical leader. With manufacturing capabilities across the United States and Europe, we help customers enhance supply security, navigate complex manufacturing challenges, and accelerate commercial success through a partnership-focused approach built on quality, transparency, and dependable execution.
sheet_notes: Contract manufacturing arm of pharma - sterile injectables

name: IDT Biologika
event_blurb:
IDT Biologika, part of SK bioscience, is a global CDMO providing end-to-end solutions for cell-culture and microbial-based proteins, vaccines, gene and immune therapeutics, biosimilars, monoclonal antibodies and sterile injectables.
With more than 100 years of biopharmaceutical experience, we partner with pharmaceutical and biotech companies throughout the entire product lifecycle—from development and technology transfer to clinical and commercial manufacturing.
Our integrated service offering includes process and analytical development, drug substance manufacturing, aseptic fill-finish, secondary packaging, and quality control. Combining flexibility, operational excellence, and regulatory expertise, we help accelerate product development and market readiness.

name: Kaneka Eurogentec
event_blurb:
Kaneka is a Japanese technology-driven chemical company offering custom synthesis services from its Health Care Business Unit positioned as a specialist CDMO partner.
We focus on small molecule chemistry with over 40 years of experience in process development, scale-up and manufacturing of Regulatory Starting Materials, GMP intermediates and APIs and support the entire drug lifecycle.
From our 4 research centers and 4 manufacturing sites in Japan and Singapore, we offer a full range of custom synthesis services based on our core technology platforms of chemical syntheses, biocatalytic transformations and flow chemistry ensuring safe, robust and sustainable processes.

name: Pathoquest
event_blurb:
PathoQuest is a global CRO that specializes in biopharma Quality Control (QC) based on Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) for viral safety and genetic characterization. The company’s proprietary NGS-based testing approach delivers actionable QC reports to the industry for cell & gene therapy, vaccines and biologics. 
With a proven track record, our expert team can support fast and robust QC testing at a GMP grade over two facilities in Europe (Paris, FR) and in the U.S. (Wayne, PA). 
PathoQuest is at the forefront of NGS-based testing solutions that accelerate the commercial availability of biopharmaceuticals and can replace current standardized in vivo and in vitro testing options. 
Biopharma Quality Control  
Faster, Safer, Animal-Free.

name: PROCOS
event_blurb:
PROCOS S.P.A. is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Japanese company, CBC Co. Ltd Group, specializing in the development, scale-up and production of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), advanced intermediates and related services for the pharmaceutical industry. 
Our core business sectors include custom synthesis and Generic API manufacturing. 
The manufacturing site is located in Cameri, Italy. This 155,000 sq. meter, cutting-edge multipurpose plant, fully designed under cGMP compliance, has been successfully audited and approved by the main regulatory authorities including AIFA, FDA and PMDA.
We are a locally rooted company yet part of an international network, with commercial offices in key strategic geographies.
